subject: U-442 round 2: F-1..F-5 landed, 9/9 mutants killed
body: Landed all five round-2 items on u-442 (head bc0fc21d4402797f937ea9d4e2ee2f567aa16b62) after merging the moved base 5df4c0d8 with no conflict: F-1 gates the tracked-at-head_sha shortcut behind a new _roots_are_split() so that under a split an artifact passes only on its artifacts[] sha256 read from the evidence root, F-2 routes the --symbol leg through the selected git context, and F-3/F-4/F-5 add the twelve regressions the tests review asked for. The four mutants that SURVIVED round 1 (M2 ignore-evidence-root, M3 remove-canonical-containment, M4 no-flag-cwd-root, M5 git_bytes-ignore-sha-root) are now all KILLED, as are M1/M6 and three new mutants on this round's own fixes — nine of nine, zero survivors; full suite exit 0 (1726 tests, OK) and scripts/validate.py exit 0 at that SHA, worktree clean. One thing needs your call and no code change was safe for it: documenting the split-authority rule in runtime/evidence-manifest.md pushed clean-sweep's activation load to ~34,059 against its 34,000 ratchet cap, so I rewrote the note to be byte-neutral (+13 chars) rather than raise the cap — that doc now has roughly five tokens of headroom, so the next behavioral note in any clean-sweep-mandatory runtime doc has nowhere to go.
